summary_md: **恒星sun ([@vintcessun](https://x.com/vintcessun/status/2116045444120039581))** summarizes **TASMAN** ([arXiv 2610.31971](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31971)): multi-party LLM negotiators with a secret saboteur usually identify the adversary within a few rounds, but agreement only improves (up to ~23 points, model-dependent) when explicitly prompted to use trust in decisions, implying memory of who is untrustworthy must actually shape planning.
